meta.title: Santa Helper – a magical Secret Santa
meta.description: Draw Secret Santa with family, friends or colleagues, hosted by Santa himself.

home.title: Turn the name draw into a show
home.modesTitle: Three ways to draw your Secret Santa

sync.title: A Secret Santa party, here and now
sync.body: Gather everyone in one room and watch it all together on the big screen. The draw still stays secret: each of you gets a private notification on your phone with your match.

hybrid.title: A live draw from anywhere
hybrid.body: Invite everyone, even if you can’t all be in one place. Each of you watches the live show from Santa’s house on your own phone or laptop.

async.title: A draw at your own pace
async.body: Set up the draw and send the invites. Everyone confirms they’re in, then checks in their own time who they’re giving a gift to this year.

home.footer: Made in Santa’s workshop. Ho ho ho!
home.heroLead: Santa hosts your Secret Santa, draws the names fairly and whispers each match to the right phone.
home.matchBody: Hold the stocking to unwrap it. Only you see the name, so the neighbours can’t peek. Try it here.
home.languagesBody: The whole show, Santa’s voice included, in five languages. Pick yours.
home.finaleBody: Set it up in a minute. Everyone else joins with a code or a quick scan of the QR.
home.joinHint: Type the 6-character code from the organiser, or paste your invite link.
home.codeNotFound: We don’t know that code. Check it with the organiser.

film.label: A little tale of Santa, who needs your help

lines.busiest: It's the busiest time of the year for me.
lines.deadline: 24 hours to deliver all the presents, and we're still not ready!
lines.letters: I'm just finishing the letters, and I more or less know who's been good this year!
lines.look: But just look at what's going on around here…
lines.elves: The elves are fooling around instead of working…
lines.time: …and Christmas Eve is getting closer and closer.
lines.trying: We’re doing our very best to get it all done, but we’ve got problems.
lines.factory: …and the conveyor belt in the gift factory has broken down!
lines.become: This year, you will play the elves, Santa’s little helpers!
lines.ready: Get ready! You’re in charge of bringing Christmas joy to your nearest and dearest!

spoken.deadline: Twenty-four hours to deliver all the presents, and we're still not ready!

ceremony.lobby1: Ho, ho, ho! Come in, come in, and warm your hands by the fire. Scan the code to join my workshop.
ceremony.welcome1: Ho, ho, ho! Good evening, my dear friends!
ceremony.welcome2: It is me, Santa Claus. Tonight my workshop is all yours. The elves have polished every bell and warmed up the cocoa.
ceremony.welcome3: We are gathered for {title}, and I can see {count, plural, one {one wonderful elf} other {# wonderful elves}}.
ceremony.elves1: Let me take a good look at you all.
ceremony.elves2: What a splendid team! Every single one of you is on my nice list this year.
ceremony.elvesRemote: And a warm wave to those joining from afar: {names}. Christmas magic works across any distance.
ceremony.rules1: Now, the rules of the workshop. Each of you will secretly get one person to surprise with a gift.
ceremony.rulesExclusions: Nobody draws themselves, and the Elf Chief has made sure some pairs stay apart, so every surprise stays a surprise.
ceremony.rulesNoSelf: Nobody draws themselves, and every name has exactly the same chance.
ceremony.rulesBudget: Keep the gift up to {budget}. It is the thought, and a little glitter, that counts.
ceremony.rulesNoBudget: There is no limit tonight, but remember: the best gifts come from the heart.
ceremony.rules2: And most important of all: keep your match a secret until the gifts are opened!
ceremony.draw1: Elves, to your places! Let the great draw begin!
ceremony.draw2: The names are tumbling, the bells are ringing…
ceremony.draw3: Done! Every name has found its elf.
ceremony.reveal1: Now, look at your own device, and hold it close to your chest.
ceremony.reveal2: Hold the gift to unwrap it. Shh, not a word to anyone!
ceremony.farewell1: That is all the magic for tonight. Thank you for visiting my workshop.
ceremony.farewell2: Merry Christmas, my dear elves! Ho, ho, ho!
ceremony.personal2: The elves have finished the great draw for {title}, and I have a little secret just for you.
ceremony.personal3: Are you ready? Here it comes…
ceremony.personalBye: Keep it secret, keep it merry. Ho, ho, ho!
